description: Permissions for every Rocinante window. The UI only reaches the core through the relay commands; it cannot spawn processes or touch the file system. It may show the system dialog to pick a project file or a folder, or where to save an exported book: the writer chooses, and the path goes to the core. A window may destroy itself, so closing it can first wait for the last text to be saved. It may go full screen for focus mode, and it draws its own title bar: it may move, minimise, maximise and close its window. It may look for a new version of Rocinante on GitHub, download it, check its signature, install it and restart, when the writer accepts. Through the host's ambience:// protocol it may read the copies of the writer's own images and sounds in the app data folder's ambience/, and nothing else.
